report.scope: 34 distinct physical directories in one owned worktree. Fresh registry per burst, fixed Native root/branch oracle and HEAD/index/config/refs byte protection. Existing machine load observed; no machine-wide stress generated. Separate latency, Node+waited-Native CPU and sampled simultaneous RSS modes. CPU excludes fixture/probe/oracle; memory mode time/CPU diagnostic only. Two rounds per request kind within one Node are correlated; use independent source Node lifetimes for comparison. No GitHub, rendered Graph or active VS Code transport latency claim.
